lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank, with higher density observed posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high pixel intensity on the superior edge and a shadow-induced low-intensity gradient on the inferior edge.
